text: should i assume anything made in here previously is going to be screwed or what ? also it seems that everything is firing off the safety guard to want to split the quads [Image #1] this is just me rotating a icosphere. also loop cut is wrong. heres how i can tell instantly: for one before i even do it the face completely broke away and is exposing a hole but secondly look [Image #2] this is not loop cutting through a cylinder which if it was  the block bench approach it would no problem. if this is still doing triangle soup then we arnt there yet
resolution: The false concavity guard and broken cylinder loop cut were separate indexed-state defects, both fixed in f69c1010d. Imported soup now records the current resident triangle-corner to stable-vertex mapping, so the first rigid gizmo transform cannot remap an older quad diagonal onto the wrong ids. Loop-cut faces now retain ordered Blockbench-equivalent polygon loops, eliminating crossed X panels and exposed holes. A repository scan found 4 of 54 saved meshdocs with incomplete part ranges; saves now repair from complete validated live ranges or refuse without overwriting the prior document.
